snippet.title: Qisah Tactics: Prelude to Deliverance, Lenovo Game Master Game Jam.
snippet.description: Qisah Tactics: Prelude to Deliverance is a turn-based strategy game set in a fantasy colonial era Southeast Asia. Using a turn-based combat and grid movement system, spiced up with a resource management system to add depth to the game mechanic.
